name: x2-att
hypothesis: Exact tier. prefill-mm-trim plus two exact kernels (exact2.metal). (1) x2_linear: multi-row 4-bit linears through mk_x2mm_q4: each 4-input quad chain of the reference tree is one simdgroup 8x8x8 step (two quads per fragment pair, the other quad's slots zeroed per lane), the dot sums, scale/bias term, per-lane sums in segment order and the pair tree over the 32 lane sums are explicit element-wise steps; tokens with a nonzero prescaled input below 2^-103 take the scalar reference tree. exact2-bench at 1,024 tokens: 2.69 / 2.83 / 2.82 / 2.85 TMAC/s vs the elite kernel's 2.07 / 2.14 / 2.15 / 1.98 (2048x2048, 6144x2048, 7680x2048, 2048x7680). (2) x2_attention: mk_attention for all rows as scores (reference dot tree), softmax scalars per (row, head, SIMD class) in step order, then value recurrences and the class merge; profile at 4,096: attention 1.20 s -> ~0.31 s per prompt. Screens: 1,024 +35.7%, 4,096 +49.5% (before the chain prefetch and the quad-pair linear). Expect +40% at 1,024, +60% at 4,096, +20% at 64.
